last_run.name: Morning Run
last_run.coach_note: Strong opener. 28 km at an aerobic HR of 148 the day before Week 1 officially starts is a statement of fitness — that pace/HR combo is well inside sub-3:10 territory. One flag: this was a 21 km week on the plan, so 28 km is a real overreach. Protect the next couple of easy days and let recovery catch up before the next hard session.

recovery.advice: Sleep dipped the night before your long run — REM and total sleep both below your recent average. Keep today easy or take a rest day; save intensity for when the numbers rebound.
